offering_description.value: Sells outdoor advertising to brands, media agencies and public agencies. It operates roadside billboards, street-level displays and airport advertising networks, offering both printed and digital placements.

primary_services.value: roadside billboard advertising; street-level advertising; airport advertising; programmatic digital ad placement

customer_segment.value: B2B: national and local advertisers, media buying agencies; B2G: public agencies buying outreach and awareness campaigns

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; entertainment; travel and hospitality; public outreach

revenue_model.value: advertising: display space on printed signs and scheduled or programmatically purchased impressions on digital screens

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates displays on owned or leased sites and under airport concessions, selling placements to advertisers and agencies; service provider: takes campaign creative from advertisers and agencies and displays it across selected locations

geography_served.value: North America: United States nationwide, with airport advertising in the Caribbean

specialization.value: related lines: roadside billboard, street-level and airport advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local and national advertising sales teams; agents / brokers: media buying agencies placing campaigns for advertisers; online: programmatic marketplaces for digital displays

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: billboard placement and digital displays are subject to the Highway Beautification Act, state sign rules and local zoning permits

notes: The current extent of its Caribbean airport coverage is uncertain.
